data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'Wig' meaning 'Battle' and 'Than' meaning 'God' or 'Man'. Wyatan represents a warrior who trusts in God or a man who embodies bravery. The name Wyatan carries the meaning “Brave Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wyatan usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wyatan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
